planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in spring or fall in reliably moist to wet soil; site along pond edges, rain gardens, or low spots that collect runoff.

directions: Sputnik is a full-size, heavy-flowering selection of native buttonbush named for its unusually large, densely packed spherical flower heads whose radiating tubular florets and projecting styles resemble the satellite. Blooms open in mid to late summer over a longer window than the straight species and are heavily worked by bumblebees, native solitary bees, and swallowtail and skipper butterflies. Like all buttonbush it tolerates standing water and periodic flooding better than almost any other flowering shrub, making it a strong choice for pond margins and bioswales, though it also grows well in average moist garden soil. Prune hard in late winter if needed to control size and encourage denser branching, since flowers form on new wood.
sources: Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center — Cephalanthus occidentalis Native Plant

common_name: Cool Splash Diervilla (Variegated White-and-Green Bush Honeysuckle)

planting.note: Plant container shrubs in spring or fall in average, well-drained to moist soil; give afternoon shade in hot climates to keep the white leaf margins from scorching.

directions: Cool Splash is a variegated sport of native bush honeysuckle with crisp white leaf margins surrounding a green center, giving a bright, cooling accent to shaded borders where most native shrubs offer only solid green foliage. Small tubular yellow flowers appear in early summer and intermittently through the season, drawing bees and the occasional hummingbird, though the foliage display is the main draw. It spreads slowly by suckers to form a tidy, low, dense colony useful for shaded groundcover-scale mass plantings or a woodland-edge border, and tolerates dry shade, heat, and humidity better than most variegated shrubs. A light shearing after the main flush of spring growth keeps the habit dense and the variegation fresh.
sources: North Carolina State Extension Plant Toolbox
